caption: Each row is one map, read left to right. The 3×3 filter turns the 5×5 input into the 3×3 conv map; its first value −4 is the worked dot product, ReLU zeroes the negatives, and 2×2 pooling with stride 1 gives 0 5 / 0 5.

spec.title: Worked example: filter, conv map, ReLU, pool
spec.aria: Four rows: the 3 by 3 filter 1 0 −1 repeated three times, the 3 by 3 convolution map −4 −1 5 −5 0 5 −4 −1 5, the ReLU map with all negatives set to zero, and the final 2 by 2 max-pooled map 0 5 0 5, each row read left to right as grid rows.
